meta.project: UmaSim /race/ 技能繁體中文漢化（第二階段）

translation_source.provenance: https://umamusumedb.com/data-sources/ : Korean and Traditional Chinese (Taiwan server) come from GameTora official in-game text. Simplified Chinese is OpenCC-converted and was NOT used.

meta.match_rule: 技能 ID == skills.json gt_id AND CSV 日文名稱 == skills.json name_jp (both required)
meta.description_rule: skills.json description_jp == data/skill_data.txt info[0] (exact string match) => skills-lite.zh-tw.json effect is the official zh-TW counterpart
integrity_policy: SkillData.name / id / info / description / invokes are NEVER modified
Translation is applied only at the Compose UI display layer
Simulator condition text (numbers, operators, percentages, distances, skill IDs, logic) is kept verbatim in Japanese
Untranslated entries fall back to the original Japanese

status_definition.verified: 可靠繁中資料（GameTora 台服官方遊戲內文本）且通過 ID + 日文名雙重核對
status_definition.translated_unverified: 已翻譯但尚無官方繁中文本可核對（僅 ui_phrases 中的模擬器提示用語）
status_definition.pending: 已通過 ID 核對，但資料庫尚無繁中文本
status_definition.unmatched: 無法可靠匹配（無 gt_id／名稱不符／繁中欄位為英文或日文回退值）
